source.message: fix(editor): bound public Page Model reads

implementation.problem: The previous Editor admission guard covered Save, Publish and administrative paths, but public page serialization shared the Page Model normalizer without a node, aggregate child-reference or hierarchy-depth budget. Legacy nested pages were recursively converted before an equivalent preflight.
behavior: Canonical models with oversized node maps, aggregate child arrays, or hierarchy depth fail closed in the shared normalizer used by public published-page and authenticated preview responses.
Legacy nested page trees are iteratively budgeted for aggregate child references and depth before recursive conversion.
Rollback checks the persisted revision's node and child-reference budgets before normalization so it preserves the API's explicit 413 limit responses and performs no writes.
Public slug lookup returns PAGE_NOT_CANONICAL for malformed content; public lists omit it; preview does not expose it.
Boundaries are covered: hierarchy depth 128 is accepted and 129 is rejected for canonical and legacy trees; a 100000-reference canonical fixture and 1000-child legacy fixture are rejected.
regressions: tests/web013-runtime.test.js covers public slug/list/preview handling and canonical/legacy child-reference and depth boundaries.
tests/f0-3-route-integration.test.js confirms oversized stored revisions preserve the 413 error contract and do not mutate page, revision, publication or audit state.
